method: PRODUCED - CONSUMED symbol parity (rg across src/, interfaces/, shared/), read-before-write triage. bin/ not present in this worktree so the equivalent production boots are reachable via src/bin/aleph-server/.

findings.produced: pub async fn CanvasStore::sweep_orphan_assets(&self, id: &str) -> Result<usize, CanvasError>
findings.rationale: Zero production callers. Orphan-sweep logic is fully exercised in production via the in-apply sweep at src/canvas/store.rs:284 (which calls the pub(super) sweep_assets_with while still inside the per-canvas critical section). The public standalone method is documented and tested but dormant — likely a future hook for a periodic cron / CLI sweep. CUT is painless, CONNECT requires adding a real wire (cron task, CLI subcommand).
findings.proposed_change: CUT path: drop the method at src/canvas/assets.rs:234-247 plus its 5 tests in #[cfg(test)] (sweep_spares_young_orphans_and_reaps_old_ones, sweep_never_touches_a_referenced_asset_however_old, a_dedup_re_put_renews_the_grace_window, apply_sweeps_old_orphans_in_passing, a_stray_file_in_the_assets_dir_is_left_alone, sweep_on_a_missing_canvas_is_not_found). CONNECT path: register a canvas.sweep_assets CLI subcommand or wire into tasks/cron.
findings.risk: low. The 5 tests pin the orphan-grace contract and can be re-derived if a real consumer is added later.
findings.verification: rg -n "sweep_orphan_assets" src/ interfaces/ shared/ should return 0 matches after CUT. rg -n "sweep_assets_with" should still show src/canvas/store.rs:284 (the in-apply sweep survives). cargo test -p alephcore --lib canvas:: should pass.

findings.rationale: Zero production callers. Both production paths that list canvases (gateway/handlers/canvas.rs:171 for canvas.list RPC and builtin_tools/canvas.rs:785 for the canvas tool List action) use list_entries() because they need to filter on owner_user_id. The list() method drops owner attribution, which the doc comment itself says is the wrong shape for callers that must visibility-filter. Dormant but correctly designed for a future 'admin sees all' caller.

KEEP path: leave dormant.
findings.risk: low. CUT removes a public method with zero callers; the two affected tests have direct list_entries() equivalents.
findings.verification: rg -n "CanvasStore::list\b" src/ interfaces/ shared/ should return 0 matches after CUT. cargo test -p alephcore --lib canvas:: should pass.

findings.produced: pub struct CanvasListing { pub owner_user_id: Option<String>, pub row: CanvasRow } + pub use store::CanvasListing
findings.consumer_location: consumed via struct-field access through the iterator returned by list_entries() — no name-import
findings.rationale: Not a severed wire. CanvasListing must be pub because the pub method list_entries() returns Vec<CanvasListing>. mod store is private, so the re-export through mod.rs is the only way external code can reference the type. The two production callers (gateway/handlers/canvas.rs:171, builtin_tools/canvas.rs:785) read entry.owner_user_id.as_deref() and entry.row.project_id.as_deref() after .into_iter() — they consume the struct, just not by name. Cosmetic only.

findings.produced: const PRUNE_AT: usize = 128; (duplicated across 3 lock tables)
findings.consumer_location: each file's own slot() and per-file test (doc_io.rs:62,213,217; btw/seed/gate.rs:69,142,146; session_store/file_backend/meta.rs:85,330,334)
findings.rationale: Three locks tables (DocLocks in canvas/doc_io, Gate in btw/seed, MetaLocks in session_store/file_backend) are modeled on the same pattern; the canvas doc explicitly cites gateway/session_store/file_backend/meta.rs as the 'twin' (src/canvas/doc_io.rs:1-19). PRUNE_AT = 128 is hand-copied into all three. Per-site tests pin the local constant, so accidental drift does not break tests, just behavior. Classic name-drift residue / shape duplication.
findings.proposed_change: If the team agrees the three locks tables should agree, hoist PRUNE_AT to crate::sync_primitives or make canvas::doc_io::PRUNE_AT canonical and have the other two re-export from it. Out of scope for this audit's cut list.
findings.risk: low. Centralization is a trivial const-hygiene change.
findings.verification: rg -n "PRUNE_AT" should be reduced to a single source-of-truth definition plus re-exports/imports.
